repos_data.description: MCP server that adds a fail-closed quality gate and hash-chained receipt ledger to any AI agent workflow.
Long-term memory for AI-coded codebases. A git blame for AI agents — but for the why. MCP server that captures the agent's reasoning live, in context, as each change is made. Local SQLite, zero deps.
Open-source team memory layer for AI coding agents — markdown files in git, user→team→org hierarchy, cross-vendor MCP server. Apache-2.0.
HotPlex — Unified access layer for AI Coding Agent.
Local task-state ledger for AI coding agents. Preserve decisions, source conclusions, evidence, and checkpoints across Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP clients.

Self-maintaining and persistent codebase memory for AI coding agents — a deterministic AST index plus agent-written notes that flag themselves stale when the code changes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via MCP + CLI.
Persistent memory for AI coding agents. Local-first, cross-session context, global knowledge, and optional autonomous task execution.

Open-source coding agent memory. Records issues, attempts, fixes and decisions, then warns your agent before it repeats an approach that already failed. Native MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity and Codex. 100% local, no cloud, no telemetry. MIT.
Governed memory for long-lived coding agents. Trust, provenance, conflict detection. Local-first.

Control what your AI can see. LeanCTX (Lean Context) is the context intelligence layer for AI agents — one local Rust binary that decides what they read, remembers what they learn, guards what they touch, and proves what they save. 60–90% fewer tokens as the receipt. 76 MCP tools, 30+ agents, local-first.

Git-native context layer for AI coding agents. Your team's real engineering decisions — patterns, pitfalls, conventions — live as reviewed markdown files in your repo; agents consult them before writing code and record what they learn. Files-first, no server required; MCP as an optional serving layer.

Triage for AI-generated code review: grades each changed diff line green/yellow/orange by impact, so reviewers spend attention where it matters. High-signal, low-noise (0 false blocks), deterministic — in your coding agent (MCP), editor (VS Code), and CLI/CI.

repo_meta_data.description: Policy enforcement layer for AI coding agents — briefing gates, team memory, Git/CI checks
